scope: Opt-in development only. The independent structural 9–10 mm scorer and original cut, motion, collision, tension, total-tick and camera-recovery guards stay unchanged. No Level 0 credit from diagnostic optics.
routine: After each accepted closure, on the next unique FSM tick check finite safety observations, tear, overcut, grasp, strain and physically closed jaws. Execute the existing 3 mm guarded back-off once, with no ECM or jaw command. Preserve initial and post-motion observations. Do not debit or reset any recovery counters for this one routine action. A motion refusal fails closed. Only after a fresh observation may the unchanged visual interlocks call guarded completion or return via ALIGN; a remaining optical failure uses ordinary recovery.
acquisition: One separate nominal truth-feedback acquisition is allowed to exercise the pair collector, never visual M5. Seed on first loaded ALIGN observation before advancing the cutter. Post-bite frames come after the guarded routine move; each is the next pair's reference. Each window binds its sequence, previous reference, accepted grip and observed routine back-off, with no further grip closure, grasp/traction change or ECM motion. Pose/readback and age are binding metadata, not features. Medium frames must pass the same three-marker/fixed-depth gate. Keep missing/failed evidence; do not stitch or replace.
geometry: Versioned bilateral optical endpoint report only. Fit small depth surfaces to visible materials just beyond the slit, lift the original image apex with both surface fits, require agreement, then compare with row-9 near-lip edges measured in depth. Do not extrapolate an occluded bank. Result is not a hidden structural certificate and cannot authorize closure, increase the sweep limit, or override original terminal checks.
geometry_replay: Use only the four historically sealed diagnostic exposures: row9 contact nominal ticks 31/32 and the two same-view noisy 8 mm negatives, selected by the prior near-lip protocol. Seal predictions before joining the registered structural labels. Requiring both positives to be ROW9_MATCH and both negatives to be BELOW is a diagnostic gate, not Level 0 or evidence at 10 mm.
